page: Google Cloud Platform a4x-maxgpu-4g-metal is an accelerator-optimized bare-metal server tailored for intensive computational demands. The platform is driven by 144 dedicated arm64 processor cores coupled with 960 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core allocation of 6.67 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA GB300 GPUs from the Blackwell family, which collectively deliver 1116 GB of total GPU video memory. Complementing the processing subsystem, the instance incorporates 12885 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage for high-throughput input and output operations, while offering zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the provision of 1116 GB of VRAM across four Blackwell GPUs alongside nearly 13 TB of local NVMe storage provides high compute and data density within a single chassis. This architecture enables deep learning datasets and parameter weights to remain locally resident, circumventing latency and bandwidth limitations associated with external network storage. An architectural tradeoff involves the arm64 instruction set, which necessitates arm64-compatible binaries and runtimes, as well as the requirement to manage routing independently due to the lack of bundled public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration is primarily suited for foundational large language model pre-training, complex multi-GPU parallel inference, high-performance computing simulations, and accelerated data processing pipelines requiring extensive local NVMe staging space.
description: Google Cloud Platform a4x-maxgpu-4g-metal is an accelerator-optimized bare-metal instance configured for intensive computational and artificial intelligence workloads. It integrates 144 dedicated arm64 vCPUs alongside 960 GB of system RAM, providing an allocation of 6.67 GB per core. Acceleration is delivered via four NVIDIA Blackwell GB300 GPUs supplying an aggregate 1116 GB of video memory. In addition to high-capacity compute and graphics acceleration hardware, the server includes 12885 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency data access. Networking provisions do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The convergence of expansive GPU memory, substantial local storage capacity, and 144 physical-tier processing cores yields a high-density footprint tailored to maximize hardware resource consolidation for extreme computational density. The configuration is aligned with large-scale deep learning model training, massive parallel AI inference pipelines, complex numerical simulations, and large-dataset accelerated analytics.
